meta.description: Mock Data and Data Availability Policy Matrix (Cases A-G)

Case_A.candidate_level_action: Allow all 100 to proceed to ranking
Case_A.portfolio_level_action: Perform full optimization on 100 eligible candidates

Case_B.candidate_level_action: Quarantine the 1 MOCK candidate; allow 99 REAL candidates to proceed to ranking
Case_B.portfolio_level_action: Perform full optimization on 99 eligible REAL candidates

Case_C.candidate_level_action: Quarantine the 20 MOCK candidates; allow 80 REAL candidates to proceed to ranking
Case_C.portfolio_level_action: Perform full optimization on 80 eligible REAL candidates

Case_D.description: Only 3 REAL candidates remain after removing MOCK candidates
Case_D.candidate_level_action: Quarantine the 97 MOCK candidates; allow 3 REAL candidates to proceed to ranking
Case_D.portfolio_level_action: Construct a degraded portfolio of only 3 candidates

Case_E.portfolio_level_action: Halt execution due to empty eligible candidate universe

Case_F.description: Price/volume data is REAL but fundamentals are MOCK
Case_F.candidate_level_action: Quarantine candidates due to mock fundamentals; they do not enter ranking
Case_F.portfolio_level_action: Halt execution if all candidates are quarantined

Case_G.description: Fundamentals are REAL but price/volume data is unavailable
Case_G.candidate_level_action: Quarantine candidates due to missing/unavailable market data; they do not enter ranking
Case_G.portfolio_level_action: Halt execution due to empty eligible candidate universe
